title: A Cake for Dan
setting: A cozy kitchen with an open window on a gray day.

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan)

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper)

sentences.en: Anna is alone in her quiet kitchen.
sentences.zh: 安娜一个人在安静的厨房里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) stands alone in a calm, tidy kitchen with a mixing bowl.

sentences.en: Dan's birthday is important to her every year.
sentences.zh: 丹的生日每年对她来说都很重要。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) hangs birthday balloons in the kitchen.
sentences.draw_note: Shows birthday balloons; 'every year' cannot be shown.

sentences.en: Once a year, she bakes him this nice cake.
sentences.zh: 她每年给他烤一次这种好吃的蛋糕。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) puts a round cake into the oven.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Anna baking; 'once a year' cannot be shown.

sentences.en: She adds sugar, fruit and a glass of milk.
sentences.zh: 她加入糖、水果和一杯牛奶。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan), in a white apron, pours a glass of milk into a bowl with sugar and fruit beside it.

sentences.en: Outside the open window, the sky is gray.
sentences.zh: 敞开的窗外，天空灰蒙蒙的。
sentences.scene_prompt: An open kitchen window shows a gray, cloudy sky; a cake cools on the sill.

sentences.en: Dan is late, but he usually comes early.
sentences.zh: 丹迟到了，可他通常都来得很早。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan), in a white apron, waits by the finished cake and looks out of the window at an empty garden path with a worried face.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Anna waiting and worried; 'late' and 'usually early' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Then she hears a sound: Dan is back!
sentences.zh: 接着她听到一个声音：丹回来了！
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan), in a white apron, turns with a smile towards the opening front door as Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) steps in.

sentences.en: "Dear, your cakes are always the best!" says Dan.
sentences.zh: “亲爱的，你做的蛋糕总是最好吃！”丹说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) eats a big piece of cake at the table and smiles at Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan).
sentences.draw_note: Shows Dan happily eating; the words are not shown.
